pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum across cl100k_base and o200k_base of mean token_delta on 32 fresh complete-disclosure pairs, equally balanced by ctl form.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated suggestions and proposal state are read before mint
the clean exact 32-pair packet is public before mint
the test set contains exactly 32 unique pairs balanced 16 per form
the comparator carries the full same-run positive-control disclosure and never uses silence
tiktoken 0.13.0 and both pinned encodings load only after mint
every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed
the result is labelled as price evidence only and as a new original, never an independent confirmation

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.acceptance: The least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across cl100k_base and o200k_base is <= -10 tokens.
estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer across all 32 pairs; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.population: all 32 frozen complete minimal disclosure pairs, 16 per form

manifest.evidentiary_limit: This deterministic carrier measures price only. It does not measure comprehension, truth, auditability, or adoption, and it is a new original rather than an independent replication.
